show.title: Happier with Gretchen Rubin
show.description:
Gretchen Rubin is HAPPIER, and she wants you to be happier too. The #1 bestselling author of The Happiness Project and Better Than Before gets more personal than ever as she brings her practical, manageable advice about happiness and good habits to this lively, thought-provoking podcast. Gretchen’s cohost and guinea pig is her younger sister, Elizabeth Craft, a TV writer and producer living in Los Angeles, who (lovingly) refers to Gretchen as her happiness bully.

episodes.title: Ep. 602: Spend Your Money at Home Instead of Away, and Why You Should Delegate
episodes.description_html:
Why you might consider spending your vacation money on a home experience that you’ll enjoy for years, and why delegating tasks is more important–and harder–than it may seem.


Episode highlights:

  • Try This at Home: Why you might "spend out" on your space, instead of on vacation, to give yourself fun and comfort at home [02:35]

  • Happiness Hack: A listener's three-system method for documenting daily life and family milestones [13:14]

  • Happiness Stumbling Block: Why we avoid delegating and how to let go, especially during the empty-nest years [17:25]

  • Demerits & Gold Stars: Elizabeth’s Demerit: still need to visit the Encino Mah Jong parlor; Gretchen’s Gold Star: Winsteads! The ice! The lacy burgers!  [25:57]
